description: This file defines a Drag object with methods to enable drag-and-drop functionality for DOM elements, including initialization, start, drag, and end handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes drag behavior on a DOM element with configuration options.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Handles the start of a drag operation, setting up mouse event tracking.

methods.name: drag
methods.description: Handles the dragging motion, updating element position based on mouse movement.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the drag operation, cleaning up event handlers.

methods.name: fixE
methods.description: Normalizes the event object for cross-browser compatibility.
